li.label: family came to visit
li.description: Family came all this way to see me. We talked all day about home: who married whom, who moved away, whose roof finally fell in.

li.label: helped strangers on the road
li.description: Some merchants were stuck on the road, and I got them moving again. They shook my hand twice before they left.

li.label: settled a quarrel
li.description: Two of our neighbors were ready to come to blows, and I got them to shake on a deal. It took all day.

li.label: we helped the neighbors
li.description: Our neighbors were sick and out of medicine, and we sent them some of ours.

li.label: buried a stranger properly
li.description: We found an old grave and buried them again, with a stone at the head. Whoever they were, they deserved that.

li.label: we robbed a grave
li.description: We dug up a stranger's grave and kept what they were buried with. It doesn't sit right with me.

li.label: an evening of old letters
li.description: We read old letters aloud after supper, two strangers writing to each other for years. I keep wondering how it ended.

li.label: a good fortune
li.description: The fortune teller saw good things ahead for me. It's only cards, but still.

li.label: a bad fortune
li.description: The fortune teller didn't like what the cards showed for me. It's only cards. I keep thinking about it anyway.

li.label: the crops are thriving
li.description: Warm nights, soft rain, and the crops are days ahead of where they should be. I could watch them grow.
